name: Tower of Easy
desc:
✅ Welcome to Tower of Easy, the most easy tower game on Roblox! ✅

🌟 Play over 350+ unique EASY stages!

🎯 Unlock over TONS of UNIQUE pets!

💾 Your progress will save AUTOMATICALLY!

🏆 Get FREE coins for staying in the game, inviting friends, & from daily login streaks!

🔒 Play in our FREE private servers!

This game is inspired by Tower of Hell and made by ToH fans.

Reach the top of the tower made of randomly generated stages before the clock runs out. Earn coins to purchase gears and server effects in the shop, and level up to climb your way up the leaderboard.
